gen-audiowide-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-n: Futuristic Audiowide marches across the top, each glyph a ribbon of constant width, while Atkinson Hyperlegible Next sits below. Its big open eyes make paragraphs go down easily, line after line.
gen-audiowide-gf-comme: Wire-like lines, laid out like tiles with wide gaps. That is Audiowide, and under it Comme runs smooth plain sans text, its lowercase filling most of the line height.
gen-audiowide-gf-fresca: Audiowide never shades a stroke from heavy to light. Its best trick is that constant line; Fresca's is a sans with counters that stay connected to outside space and short ascenders.
gen-audiowide-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans keeps stroke widths steady from stem to curve. Both fonts refuse to swell or thin a line, which is the quality that ties Audiowide's futuristic tiles to this sans.
gen-audiowide-gf-gafata: Contemporary Gafata fills a tall band of lowercase, short stalks above and wide-eyed e's throughout. And Audiowide earns its keep big and brief, its strokes never swelling or thinning.
gen-audiowide-gf-geist: Audiowide spaces its glyphs with wide gaps between them, futuristic and tall in the lowercase. And Geist, in plain sans, settles into a quiet level beat where words read as solid blocks.
gen-audiowide-gf-hind-siliguri: Approachable meets futuristic here: Audiowide draws glyphs with wide gaps, each drawn with a constant line. Hind Siliguri hums along beneath in plain sans, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle.
gen-audiowide-gf-karla: Unshaded lines, wide-spaced, lead the way. Audiowide earns its keep big and brief, while Karla, in plain sans, brings a gaping c opening and a stocky, tall middle band.
gen-audiowide-gf-khula: Audiowide's strokes carry essentially zero contrast, like tiles laid with wide grout between each glyph. And Khula's plain sans curves hold their mouths open, so extended text keeps moving.
gen-audiowide-gf-lexend: Audiowide goes futuristic and wide-spaced, every stroke held constant. What binds it to Lexend's plain sans is thickness that never budges, round the curves and down the stems alike.
